headline: Isgec Heavy Engineering appoints Mahua Chakrabarty as CHRO
hook: New HR chief for Isgec Heavy Engineering
summary: Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited has announced the appointment of Ms. Mahua Chakrabarty as the Chief Human Resources Officer and a senior management personnel of the company. The appointment is scheduled to take effect from October 1, 2026. For an Indian retail investor, routine senior management changes at mid-cap engineering firms generally have a negligible impact on stock price movement.
why_it_matters: Routine leadership change with no immediate financial impact
